name: Ginger Tea
siboNotes: Fresh ginger tea is well-tolerated and may help with digestive symptoms and nausea, making it beneficial for SIBO management.
preparationTips: Use fresh ginger root for best flavor and digestive benefits
Steep 1-2 inches of sliced fresh ginger in hot water for 5-10 minutes
Add a slice of lemon for extra flavor without FODMAPs
Strain out ginger pieces before drinking if desired
